verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a first-party European Payments suite (Payment Initiation) for real-time payments without entering account details, and gives its footprint as '18 European markets'. That is a direct, documented pay-by-bank product. Auth only supplies account and routing numbers so the developer can initiate ACH or wire transfers elsewhere, which is a building block rather than Plaid initiating the payment, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: an enumerated list of the live countries (only a count of 18 is given), any Plaid-initiated payment product outside Europe, documentation of the initiation API flow itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration that payments work in production.

support.subject: As a developer, I can initiate a bank payment from a connected account — a documented pay-by-bank or payment-initiation product with its live geographies stated honestly

citations.quote: Plaid's European Payments suite enables your users to make real-time payments without manually entering their account details or leaving your app.
Verify user accounts, manage risk, and move money across 18 European markets, all through a single Plaid integration.
